svg.aria-label: An independent structural-kinetics teaching model uses 0.1 s⁻¹, 100 s⁻¹ and 0.1 s⁻¹ for gentle observation, strong shearing and recovery. Viscosity is mapped from this model’s structural variable; this is a separate model from the earlier Carreau fluid.
